title: C2 Milestone 2: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el segundo hito del nivel C2. Tu dominio de los condicionales invertidos, la concordancia precisa y el léxico corporativo te posiciona al nivel de la alta dirección. ¡Continuamos hacia la cima!

parts.visual:
En este segundo hito de C2 evaluaremos tu maestría en las lecciones 6 a 9: 

1. Advanced Conditionals: Provided that, Unless, Inversión condicional (Should you, Were I, Had we known). 
2. Subject-Verb Agreement: The committee is/are, None of them is (formal), The number of (singular) vs A number of (plural), fractions.
parts.audio: In this second C2 milestone, we will evaluate your mastery of lessons 6 to 9. We will test Advanced Conditionals, such as Provided that, Unless, and Conditional Inversion like Should you, Were I, and Had we known. We will also review Subject-Verb Agreement nuances with collective nouns, 'None of', 'The number of' versus 'A number of', and fractions.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos Vocabulario Corporativo y Diplomacia: 

3. High-Level Finance: Revenue, Overhead, EBITDA, Liquidity, Amortization, Assets/Liabilities. 
4. Diplomatic Refusal: With all due respect, I beg to differ, I have my reservations, Out of the question, Let's agree to disagree. 

¡Demuestra tu precisión gramatical y tu tacto ejecutivo!
parts.audio: We will also review High-Level Finance and Diplomatic Refusal. From Finance: terms like Revenue, Overhead, EBITDA, Liquidity, Amortization, Assets, and Liabilities. From Diplomatic Refusal: phrases like With all due respect, I beg to differ, I have my reservations, Out of the question, and Let's agree to disagree. Show your grammatical precision and executive tact!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio C2 en este examen integral.

questions.question: Normal: If we had known about the bankruptcy, we wouldn't have invested. -> Inversion: ____ we known about the bankruptcy, we wouldn't have invested.
questions.explanation: Inversión de tercer condicional: Had we known.

questions.question: I am willing to overlook this mistake ____ that it never happens again. (Siempre y cuando).
The board of directors ____ divided on whether to accept the merger proposal. (Actuando como individuos en desacuerdo).
questions.explanation: Como están divididos, actúan como individuos: are.

questions.question: Neither of the two financial models ____ accurately predicting our Q4 revenue. (Gramática formal).
questions.explanation: Formalmente, Neither of toma verbo singular: is.

questions.question: A number of critical flaws ____ found during the software audit.
questions.explanation: A number of (varios) toma verbo plural: were.

questions.question: We need to reduce our ____ (rent, utilities, insurance) if we want to improve our profit margins.
Spreading the cost of a new patent over its useful life is known as ____.
The company's ____ was severely compromised, meaning they couldn't pay their short-term debts.
____ all due respect, I think your analysis is based on outdated data.
You claim the project is viable, but looking at the numbers, I ____ to differ.
Accepting a deal that loses us money is completely ____ of the question.
questions.explanation: Out of the question = fuera de discusión.

questions.question: I have my ____ about partnering with a firm that has such a poor reputation. (Dudas).
____ it rain during the outdoor gala, we will move everything to the main hall. (Inversión).
questions.explanation: Should it rain = If it rains.

questions.question: Half of the budget ____ already been allocated to marketing.
The total amount of money brought in by a company's operations is its ____.
Since we are deadlocked, let's just agree to ____ and move on to the next topic.
The number of complaints ____ decreased significantly since the new update.
questions.explanation: The number of (la cantidad) toma singular: has.

questions.question: I must take ____ with your assertion that our customer service is failing.
____ I the CEO, I would fire him immediately. (Inversión).
The CEO, along with the CFO and COO, ____ attending the summit in Davos.
questions.explanation: The CEO (singular). 'along with' no cambia el sujeto principal: is.

questions.question: ____ we known the truth. (Inversión 3er condicional)
None of them ____ ready. (Formal - is/are)
A number of issues ____ found. (was/were)
Total ____. (Ingresos/Facturación con R)
Reduce ____. (Gastos fijos con O)
____ of an intangible asset. (Amortización con A)
With all ____ respect. (Debido con D)
I ____ to differ. (Disiento con B)
Out of the ____. (Fuera de discusión con Q)
Agree to ____. (Estar en desacuerdo)
